metaDescription: SEO for businesses on Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao — on-page, technical, local search and AI search optimization in one strategy.
directAnswer: CreativeLAB is an SEO agency working with businesses on Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao. We cover the full discipline — on-page content, technical SEO, local search visibility and AI search (GEO) optimization — as one coordinated strategy, not a single narrow service sold on its own.
heroSupport: On-page, technical, local and AI search optimization for businesses that need to be found — by search engines and by AI answer engines.
heroImageAlt: SEO strategy and search performance reviewed on a laptop screen
overview: SEO is often sold as one narrow thing — a monthly report, a handful of blog posts, or a technical audit nobody implements. We treat it as a full discipline made up of several parts that only really work together: what your pages say and how they're structured, whether search engines can technically crawl and understand your site, whether your business shows up correctly in local and Maps search, and — increasingly — whether AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews can accurately describe and recommend your business.

This is the general SEO page for CreativeLAB's work across Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao — it's the only page on the site dedicated to SEO strategy as a whole. For local search and Google Business Profile specifically, see our Local SEO service. For the technical foundations of a website, see Technical SEO. For AI search visibility specifically, see AI Search / GEO. Each of those pages goes deeper into its own part of the discipline; this page explains how they fit together and where to start.

Island businesses face a particular SEO challenge: search volume for any single keyword is modest compared to a major city, but competition for visibility is often surprisingly high, because most local businesses share the same few directories, the same generic descriptions, and often no real content strategy at all. That means a clearly differentiated, well-structured site can move up faster here than in a saturated market — but it also means generic, templated content barely moves the needle.

We start every SEO engagement with a strategy phase — understanding what your customers are actually searching for, on which of the three islands, and at what stage of their decision — before touching a single page. From there, the work splits across on-page content, technical fixes, local search presence and, where relevant, AI search structuring, prioritized by what will actually move a specific business forward rather than a generic checklist.

faqs.q: Is this different from the Local SEO, Technical SEO and AI Search pages?
faqs.a: Yes — this is the only general SEO strategy page on the site, covering how those pieces fit together. Local SEO, Technical SEO and AI Search / GEO are each their own detailed service page for that specific part of the work.

faqs.q: Do I need all of on-page, technical, local and AI search work, or can I start with one part?
faqs.a: You can start with one — most clients begin with a technical and content audit, then expand into local or AI search work once the foundation is solid.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes can improve crawlability quickly; meaningful ranking movement typically builds over 1–3 months and compounds from there.

faqs.q: Do you write the content, or just advise on strategy?
faqs.a: Both — we write and implement the on-page content and technical changes, not just hand over recommendations.

faqs.q: What is AI search / GEO, and do I actually need it?
faqs.a: It's structuring your content so AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews can accurately describe and cite your business. It's increasingly relevant alongside traditional SEO, not instead of it, for any business relying on being found online.

faqs.q: Can you improve SEO for a business operating across more than one island?
faqs.a: Yes — strategy and content are built to represent each island's presence distinctly rather than treating the whole region as one generic location.
No — we never fabricate guarantees or invented ranking promises; we implement the strategy and technical work known to support visibility and report honestly on progress.
Regular reporting on visibility, rankings where trackable, and the specific work completed each period, in plain language.
